content: Abramaw Lothaw dhadh poelgemoedhin

Abraman nanga adhapa wayadhin Aykupithungu, nuy a nungu ipi a nungu mura zagethaw mabaygal, a mura tetel uruyl, a mura nungu zapul, thana naygay doegampa adhapa memayidhin Aykupithungu. Nubiya kalmel nungu tukuypaw kazi Lotha. Kurusipa thana Kananaw zaya doegam gasamoedhin.
Abram nuy mina koey ayde zapul mabayg. Nuy kedha, mamuylayg, nanilayg, a kawalayg; a nubiya lak koethil zapul, silba a goli.

Sizi nuy lak miyaydhin war doegampa. Nuy kedha meparu, urapu lagoenu thuma oesiginga, kurusipa nuy Bethela mangaydhin. Thana si thawpay thonarpa mudh yoewthadhin Bethel war doegapa a Ay war doegapa, thana kulay ngalaga nanga kawa mudhaw lag aymoedhin,
a olta moeydhadhin. Thana nanga si kulay aymayzi oltanu mangemidhin, Abram lak Awgadhoepa thoeythupoegaydhin.
Matha Abram lawnga koey uruylayg, nungu tukuypaw kazi Lotha lak kedha koey uruylayg, mamuylayg, nanilayg, kawalayg. Nuy lak nungu geth ipi kazilayg, a zagethaw maoebaygoelayg.
Senabi thonara nanga palamun kalmel tetel uruypa bup matha ngoedhagidh lawnga, thana ngalagiya na mudh thoemaypu thana kasa mura bup urapun goeyginu eygi thoeyaypa purthaypu.
Abraman a Lothan uruy danal poethay mabaygal kidhakidhan wati igalgal aymoeydhin, yaynanob uruy may. (Senabi thonara nanga thana Kananalgal a Perezaythalgal, thana matha memayipu sethabi doegamoenu.)
Kalanu Abram Lothalpa kedha mulaydhin, ‘Ipal ngoeba urapu kulkaw mabayg, thana kidhakidhan ya poeybayginga nay.
Matha ngoedhagidh kedha ngoeba bangal dhadh pulgemoene. Ngi kulay nginu midh doegampa ubi, kasa ubipa doegam ngibepa mar nginu uruypa matha ngoedhagidh, ngay wadgoepa uzaripa.’

Nuy Lotha karaypa gima nagaydhin a gurguy nagaydhin, nuydh imadhin Yuridhaw koesa, nanu doegam, mura kedha naygay kurusipa Zoa senabi doegam mina koey ngukilnga, Awgadhaw Dharbaw lag midh nanga, a Aykupithu midh nanga. Senabi thonara nanga Sodom a Gomara sepalbi ukasar goegath matha memampu, Awgadhoepa palay matha idimoeyginga.

Lotha mura padagi dhadhar sakar nubepa madhin Yuridhaw koesa ngalagiya na thoeraypa. Nuy kalanu Abramalngu sager doegampa adhapa miyaydhin sipa Yuridhaw koesapa. Senaw palamun dhadh poelamay kedha kuniya aymoeydhin.
Lotha nanga miyaydhin nuy Abram matha meparu adhal bupanu Kanananu. A Lotha kay goegathoepa thamaydhin, nuydh nungu kawamudhaw lagal aymoeydhin padagi dhadhasakara, Sodomoepa amadhan.
Thana kay nanga setha Sodomaw mabaygal thana mina adhapudhay wati pawaw mabaygal. Thana Awgadhoepa wati pawal aymoeypu, Awgadhaw mina nanga pathidhaypu.
Abram Kananangu Ebronoepa thamaydhin
Lotha nanga thamaydhin, nungu kalanu Awgadh Abramalpa mulaydhin kedha, ‘Senaw ngi ngalaga nanga mepa mamu kay mina nagi mura wad wad gampa.
In mura kapu boeradhar, ngath bangal ngibepa manine a nginu kaziw kazipa. In mura nubi kapu boeradhar bangal pamoeygoepa ingaru nginu za, nginu kaziw kaziw geth niyaylag.’
Awgadhan kedha mulaydhin Abramalpa, ‘Ngath bangal nanga ngin kazil palane’
‘Ngath bangal nanga ngin kazil palane buthudh koeygarsar, mabaygoepa gethatidaypa matha ngoedhagidh lawnga.
Wa uzar, ngidh mura iman nabi koey boeradhar nabi buwadhoengu wara buwadhoepa, in bangal ngath ngibepa manine mura.’
Kalanu Abram thamaydhin a mudh yoewthadhin, Mamren adhapa thamayzi puyl doegamoenu amadhan Ebronoenu nuy Mamre wara kuyku mabayg Ebronoenu. Nuydh Abrama kalanu si kulaw olta moeydhadhin Awgadhoepa.
